title: Neural Maze's Rust & vLLM Production OCR Course
excerpt: The neural-maze/production-ocr-course offers a comprehensive, hands-on guide to constructing scalable OCR pipelines using a modern DevOps stack. It covers Rust for performance, vLLM for efficient LLM inference, Redis messaging, KEDA autoscaling, and Kubernetes orchestration, making it essential for engineers deploying AI at scale.
description: Neural Maze's Production OCR course offers a hands-on guide to building scalable OCR pipelines with Rust, vLLM, Redis, KEDA, and Kubernetes for modern AI infrastructure.
